flag_reason: Two-node cycle resolved: Set Policy subclassOf ContractualAgreement. Reasoning: Policy is a specific instance of a ContractualAgreement. A ContractualAgreement is a broad, general term referring to any formal agreement between parties that defines terms and obligations. A Policy, on the other hand, is a specific type of contractual agreement used in the context of insurance, with defined coverage, premiums, and conditions. Therefore, ContractualAgreement is the broader category (Superclass), and Policy is a more specific type (Subclass). This makes Option A the semantically sound relationship.
